newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine jobless rate down to 10.4 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Philippine jobless rate down to 10.4 pct in April.

text.p: The Philippines' jobless rate fell to 10.4 percent in April compared with the year-ago 10.9 percent, the National Statistics Office reported on Friday.
The data showed 3.3 million people were unemployed in April versus 3.4 million last year, the agency said.
The total labor force participation in April was 31.4 million versus 30.7 million last year.
The April survey also revealed that there were more people underemployed at 6.6 million or 23.4 percent of the employed. This compares with last year's 6.1 million or 22.2 percent of the employed.

Among the sectors, the services segment employed the most, with its share to total employment at 41.8 percent. This was followed by the agricultural sector at 41.3 percent; and industry, 16.9 percent.

The National Statistics Office comes out with surveys on the labour force once every three months. Its April survey usually shows a higher number of labour force population due to the entry of graduates in the job market.
